newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed march delivery prices recovered to 1,137/1,138 rupees on Monday after falling to 1,134/1135 on speculative buying, dealers said.
Shortcovering by bear operators to book profit helped the modest recovery but overall, sentiment remained quiet amid limited export inquiries, said dealer Dilip Thakkar.

Most of the outstanding business in the December delivery has switched over to March delivery and traders were expecting low volumes for December, he said. Groundnut oil fell to 350/352 rupees from 357/368 on higher new crop arrivals.
In Rajkot, spot oil fell by 10 to 530 rupees per 15 kg.
